name: E2E Tests

permissions:
  contents: read

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "Clients/**"
      - "Servers/**"
      - ".github/workflows/e2e-tests.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      only_last_failed:
        description: "Only re-run tests that failed in the previous workflow run"
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

jobs:
  e2e-tests:
    name: Playwright E2E Tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ matrix.total }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    # Each shard is its own job with its own Postgres and Redis, so tests that
    # depend on earlier tests' data still run in order within a shard and
    # cannot see another shard's data. Playwright runs the setup projects a
    # shard's tests depend on inside that shard.
    #
    # Each shard spends ~3 minutes on setup before its first test, so beyond
    # about 5 shards the setup dominates and more shards barely help.
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
        total: [5]

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: verifywise_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

      redis:
        image: redis:7
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          # jsdom 30.x (used by Servers) requires Node >= 22.22.2.
          node-version: '22'
          # Caches npm's download cache (not node_modules), keyed on both lockfiles.
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: |
            Servers/package-lock.json
            Clients/package-lock.json

      # ---- Backend setup ----
      - name: Install backend dependencies
        working-directory: Servers
        run: npm ci --legacy-peer-deps

      - name: Build backend
        working-directory: Servers
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run migrations
        working-directory: Servers
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_NAME: verifywise_test
          DB_USER: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          # Required by the RLS runtime-role migration (rls-app-role.js), which
          # fails closed without it. CI-only value; not a real credential.
          DB_APP_PASSWORD: test-app-role-password-for-ci
          SUPERADMIN_EMAIL: admin@verifywise-test.com
          SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD: TestAdmin!Str0ng
        run: npx sequelize db:migrate

      - name: Seed test data
        working-directory: Servers
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_NAME: verifywise_test
          DB_USER: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          # Re-create/refresh the super-admin so E2E login credentials are always valid.
          SUPERADMIN_EMAIL: admin@verifywise-test.com
          SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD: TestAdmin!Str0ng
        run: node dist/scripts/seedTestData.js

      # ---- AIGateway setup ----
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7

          python-version

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
